messages.author: 2859cc8d88b962be
messages.subject: Cloudera 5.x RHIPE install and classpaths
parts:
Hi All,

I've got a small cluster built with Cloudera's 5.0 release of CDH. R is installed along with Rhipe and the protobuf. R starts and I can load Rhipe. When I issue the rhinit() command I get the following error:

> rhinit()
Rhipe: Using Rhipe.jar file
Initializing Rhipe v0.73
Error in .jnew("org/godhuli/rhipe/PersonalServer") :
  java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: org/apache/hadoop/io/Writable

In searching on this error is appears that the class paths aren't defined. But as most of the solutions to the error seem to be for CDH4 rather than CDH5. The issue here is that there are differences between CDH4's layout and CDH5's.

The following is defined in custom.sh script for bashrc:

export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/lib

export HADOOP_HOME=/usr/lib/hadoop
export HADOOP_CMD=/usr/lib/hadoop/client
export HADOOP_BIN=/usr/lib/hadoop/bin
export HADOOP_CONF_DIR=/etc/hadoop/conf
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/java/jdk1.6.0_31

So my question is has anyone been working with CDH5, R and Rhipe and what classpaths are still needed in my setup?

Regards
TimW
